behaviour: qrco.de is the short-link domain of QR Code Generator PRO. Its help center says that after the trial, dynamic codes are deactivated and point to a service page.
l.ead.me is a short-link domain named on the help pages of QR Code Generator PRO. Its help center says that after the trial, dynamic codes are deactivated and point to a service page.
